title: SCIM provisioning
description: Configure SCIM 2.0 endpoints for identity provider provisioning and sync history.

empty.title: No SCIM endpoints
empty.description: Create a SCIM endpoint to issue a bearer token and expose McHarbor users and groups to compatible identity providers.

delete.title: Delete SCIM endpoint?
delete.warning: Provisioning clients using this endpoint token will stop working immediately.

history.title: Sync history for {{name}}
history.description: Recent SCIM sync attempts and object counts.
history.counts: {{seen}} seen, {{linked}} linked, {{unmatched}} unmatched, {{updated}} updated, {{disabled}} disabled, {{skipped}} skipped, {{groups}} groups

editor.name: Name
editor.tokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
editor.tokenAutoGenerate: Leave blank to auto-generate a bearer token
editor.tokenHint: Secrets are encrypted at rest and never returned after creation.

token.title: Copy SCIM bearer token
token.description: This token for {{name}} is shown once.
token.warning: Copy this token now. McHarbor stores only an encrypted secret and cannot show it again.

preview.title: Preview sync for {{name}}
preview.description: A dry run reads the directory and compares it with McHarbor. Nothing changes until you run the sync.
preview.failed: The directory could not be read
preview.queuedNote: The sync runs on the next poller tick, within a minute, and reads the directory again, so it applies what the directory says at that moment.
preview.groups: {{count}} groups read, {{matched}} match a McHarbor group by name. Groups are reported only; a sync does not change group membership.

blocked.empty_directory: The directory returned no users while accounts are still linked. The sync is blocked so it cannot disable every account at once.
blocked.directory_too_large: There are more accounts than a sync can safely compare, so the sync is blocked.

reason.protected_admin: holds a wildcard role, so a sync never disables it
reason.already_linked: the account is already linked to another directory user

change.noAccount: no McHarbor account, recorded for review

rotate.title: Rotate the bearer token for {{name}}?
rotate.description: A new token is generated and shown once. The current token stops working immediately, so update every client that uses it.
